name: What are the different levels of drywall finishing?

mainEntity.name: What are the different levels of drywall finishing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drywall finishing has different levels, typically ranging from Level 0 to Level 5, each defining the quality of the finish. Level 4 is commonly used for standard paint finishes, providing a smooth surface with taped joints and covered fasteners. Level 5 offers the highest quality, where a thin skim coat is applied over the entire surface, ideal for very critical lighting or glossy paints. Your choice depends on the intended wall covering and desired aesthetic.
acceptedAnswer.description: Drywall finishing levels range from 0 to 5, with Level 4 common for paint and Level 5 for the smoothest, high-gloss finishes.
